field_identity_rule: Analytical outputs use the existing STIMES.ITEM namespace as their canonical field identity. No second master-field identifier is created, because STIMES_ITEM_REGISTRY_v0 explicitly separates analytical items from observed/master FIELD_ID values.
definition: Proteccion juridica vigente, valida y efectivamente aplicable al taxon en La Rioja, preservando por separado evidencia normativa original, normalizacion, seleccion de la proteccion mas restrictiva, score analitico y confiabilidad.

provider.existing_scale: 0-100 when positive applicable legal protection is evidenced; null/UNKNOWN otherwise
provider.existing_aggregation: MAX current applicable evaluable legal record with jurisdiction weights
provider.rule: Existing 05 evidence and score are preserved. STIMES adds a versioned effective-protection selection because the current item requirement treats territorial applicability as an eligibility gate rather than a score penalty.

stimes_selection.territorial_rule: Any autonomous-community rule outside La Rioja is EXTERNAL_AUTONOMOUS_REFERENCE and is excluded even if upstream data mislabeled it as national.
stimes_selection.currentness_rule: Repealed, superseded, modified-away or source-marked-not-current evidence cannot produce the current score; it remains immutable historical evidence.
stimes_selection.tie_rule: If several current valid applicable records have the same highest score_100, preserve all as co-effective evidence and choose a deterministic short display reference without deleting alternatives.

semantic_states.PROTECTED: A current valid applicable record is selected
semantic_states.SIN_PROTECCION: A complete valid search across the configured authorized source set found no current valid applicable protection for a sufficiently resolved taxon
semantic_states.NO_COMPROBADO: The complete legal check required by the item has not been completed
semantic_states.SOURCE_NOT_ACQUIRED: One or more required sources could not be acquired
semantic_states.TAXON_UNRESOLVED: Taxonomic identity is insufficiently resolved for a legal assertion
semantic_states.UNKNOWN: Current protection cannot be determined from the acquired evidence
semantic_states.CONFLICT: Currentness, applicability, taxonomy or legal relationship remains materially contradictory after deterministic rules

missingness.rule: Provisional zero is permitted only as a downstream computational contribution; it never changes the semantic protection state and never becomes evidence of no protection.

source_priority.caution: Consolidated informational texts do not replace the legally authoritative official publication where legal certainty is required.

verified_current_legal_framework.current_framework: Ley 2/2023, de 31 de enero, de biodiversidad y patrimonio natural de La Rioja, modificada por Ley 2/2025, de 23 de mayo
verified_structures: Registro Riojano de Especies Silvestres en Regimen de Proteccion Especial
verified_current_legal_framework.historical_relation: Decreto 59/1998 is repealed as a norm but prior records remain historical/provenance; transitional/current annex effects must be resolved from the current law and implementing acts.

verified_structures: Listado de Especies Silvestres en Regimen de Proteccion Especial

verified_current_legal_framework.verified_effect: Article 13 requires a system of strict protection for plant species in Annex IV(b); taxon-level annex membership and Spanish implementation must be verified before scoring.
Direct EU wildlife-trade controls use Annexes A-D; current annex membership/version must be verified before scoring.

category_equivalence.rule: Literal category is immutable. Normalized category and numeric score are derived fields tied to the table version.
category_equivalence.change_policy: New table version + full recalculation; never rewrite original evidence.

reliability.requested_formula: sum(weights of checked components) / sum(total component weights) * 100
reliability.rule: No numeric confidence or display category is invented until weights and thresholds are formally versioned. Checked/total component counts are still stored so incomplete evidence is objectively distinguishable.

on_taxon_query.rule: A taxon request refreshes every automatically refreshable LOCALIZACION_Y_SELECCION item, not only PROTECCION.

dependencies.rule: No URGENCIA or PRIORIDAD formula is implemented in this PROTECCION execution.

storage_mapping.rule: PROTECCION is versioned analytical enrichment/evidence attached to the taxon resource, not a mutable accession/population field.

excel_view.territorial_columns_rule: Display source-original current categories, never replace literal legal category with JBLR score.
excel_view.effective_norm_rule: Short reference to the current valid applicable most-restrictive selected norm; complete co-effective and alternative records remain internal.
excel_view.evidence_rule: One short auditable reference to effective evidence; full chain remains in STIMES.

known_provider_defects_or_gaps.finding: Some EIDOS-derived records from Castilla-La Mancha are present in the 05 final workbook as scope Nacional/APPLICABLE_NATIONAL despite containing a non-La-Rioja autonomous sub_country.
known_provider_defects_or_gaps.stimes_rule: A non-La-Rioja sub_country is an exclusion signal regardless of the upstream national label; retain the source record and record corrected applicability as a derived STIMES resolution.

known_provider_defects_or_gaps.finding: At least one CITES Appendix II record in the existing evidence is normalized to CITES_A_OR_APPENDIX_I.
known_provider_defects_or_gaps.stimes_rule: Do not score such a record effectively until the literal annex/appendix and current primary legal source have been reconciled.
